available.quote: An individual who holds an active real estate license issued by another jurisdiction within the United States may apply for a Kentucky license by first: 1. Completing the application forms; 2. Passing the state law portion of the licensing examination; and 3. Fulfilling all other pre-license qualifications as outlined in this chapter.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold an active real estate license from another U.S. jurisdiction, complete the application, pass the state law portion of the licensing examination, fulfill all other pre-license qualifications, and provide a certification of good standing from the prior jurisdiction including license history and disciplinary information.
requirements.quote: All individuals who have held a real estate license in another jurisdiction, whether the license is currently active or canceled, shall be required to furnish, as part of his or her application for a Kentucky license, a certification of good standing, issued by the jurisdiction.

exists.quote: There is hereby created the Kentucky Real Estate Commission. The Governor shall appoint seven (7) persons, at least six (6) of whom, immediately prior to the date of their appointment have been residents of the state for ten (10) years and whose vocation for a period of at least ten (10) years shall have been that of an active real estate licensee.

national_association.value: National Association of Realtors / Kentucky Association of Realtors

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice real estate brokerage with respect to real estate located in this state unless: (a) The person holds a license to practice real estate brokerage under this chapter

credential_type.quote: No person shall practice real estate brokerage with respect to real estate located in this state unless: (a) The person holds a license to practice real estate brokerage under this chapter

is_mandatory.quote: Any person engaging in real estate brokerage without a license shall be guilty of a Class A misdemeanor for a first offense and a Class D felony for any subsequent offenses.

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person who is not licensed as a real estate broker or sales associate to: (a) Hold himself or herself out to the public as a real estate broker or sales associate or use any terms, titles, or abbreviations which express, infer, or imply that the person is licensed as a real estate broker or sales associate

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice real estate brokerage with respect to real estate located in this state unless: (a) The person holds a license to practice real estate brokerage under this chapter

definition_quote.value: Real estate brokerage means a single, multiple, or continuing act of dealing in time shares or options, selling or offering for sale, buying or offering to buy, negotiating the purchase, sale, or exchange of real estate, engaging in property management, leasing or offering to lease, renting or offering for rent, or referring or offering to refer for the purpose of securing prospects, any real estate or the improvements thereon for others for a fee, compensation, or other valuable consideration

escrow_account_required.quote: A principal broker shall maintain an escrow account or accounts, separate from the individual or office account, in which all contract deposits and money belonging to others shall be deposited without unreasonable delay.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: No principal broker shall maintain a branch office outside a one hundred (100) mile radius of the main office without having a broker managing the branch office.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: "Sales associate" means any person licensed in accordance with KRS 324.046(2) that is affiliated with a Kentucky-licensed principal broker and who, when engaging in real estate brokerage, does so under the supervision of the principal broker
